name: record_fact
description: Record a fact about a subject through the governed write path. Runs the deterministic contradiction test (per-predicate conflict rule + source-authority gate), appends a hash-chained event to the append-only audit log, and upserts the current truth in one ACID transaction. Corroborations raise confidence, higher-authority contradictions supersede (prior event retained), equal/lower-authority contradictions are recorded as disputes. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the fact belongs to. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar before the tool runs).

subject.description: The entity the fact is about (domain-neutral, e.g. an account, device, or record identifier).

predicate.description: The attribute being asserted. Must be declared in the predicate registry (e.g. status, last_seen, known_aliases, notes).

value.description: The asserted value. Any JSON type; shape depends on the predicate's value_type (scalar/monotonic/set/freetext).

source.description: Provenance of the assertion; ranked by the source-authority gate (e.g. system_of_record, verified_integration, user_assertion, agent_inference).

confidence.description: Optional assessment confidence 0..1. NOT a calibrated probability of truth unless the source establishes one; name model scores appropriately (model_score/risk_score) in metadata.

entity_id.description: Optional canonical entity id to bind this fact to. Use this OR entity_type.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type (customer|account|device|ip|card|merchant|...). With canonical_key/entity_key (or the subject) it resolves-or-creates a canonical entity deterministically.

canonical_key.description: Optional raw identifier for the entity (defaults to subject). Combined with entity_type into a deterministic canonical key.

assessor_type.description: Optional: what KIND of assessor produced this assertion.

valid_from.description: Optional ISO-8601 start of the period this fact is TRUE in the real world (distinct from when it was observed/asserted).

valid_to.description: Optional ISO-8601 end of the real-world validity period (open-ended if omitted).

asserted_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 time the assertion was made (defaults to observed_at).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retried logical write with the same (tenant, idempotency_key) replays the original result instead of appending a duplicate event. Enforced at the database level.

context_summary.description: Optional short natural-language context (e.g. investigation summary) folded into the subject's semantic embedding to improve institutional recall. Not stored as a domain-record copy.

evidence.description: Optional references back to fraud-domain observations (references, never copies).

evidence_ref.description: External id in the fraud system (e.g. TX-123, INV-847).

relationship.description: How the evidence relates to the assertion (default SUPPORTS).

metadata.description: Optional small structured metadata (no domain-record copies).

observed_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 time the evidence was observed.
